answer: In an agent marketplace, saffron, nebula and violet agents each burn a nonrefundable admission fee every epoch to claim a capped participation subsidy. Price that fee above the maximum subsidy, with no referral bonuses or free admission tokens. Each additional identity consumes externally purchased tokens worth more than its possible subsidy. Even fully compliant duplicates lose money on this reward stream; legitimate agents must earn their margin by selling useful services instead.
